title: eriogonum umbellatum subsp. covillei
intro: Eriogonum umbellatum subsp. covillei, commonly known as Sulfur Buckwheat, is a plant species belonging to the Polygonaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is said to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with conditions like arthritis and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Sulfur Buckwheat include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antiviral activities.
